title: 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops Shimmer #94/299 Franz Wagner Orlando Magic
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops basketball trading card featuring Franz Wagner of the Orlando Magic. It is a Shimmer Prizm parallel card numbered 067/299, part of the 2024-25 set. The card is manufactured by Panini. It is from the National Basketball Association (NBA) league and does not contain an autograph.
